params.note: Catalog v6.1 (D-B103, D-B104, D-B108): catalog v4.1 events relocated with NonLinLoc in the merged model v0.4.2, with source-specific station terms (NLL-SSST, characteristic distances 9999 and 16 km) and waveform-coherence relocation (NLL-coherence), on the re-timed and clock-corrected picks (v4.1tc); magnitudes recomputed with these hypocentres; events NonLinLoc does not locate have no hypocentre.
params.magnitudes_text: Magnitudes: converged Route A preferred magnitudes (exact station-term solver, D-B091; M, M_type ML / Mw / Mw_cal) computed with the v6.1 hypocentres (D-B105; magnitude_source v6.1_converged) where that table has a magnitude for the event, else the v4.1 table (v4 hypocentres; v4.1_converged).
params.hypocentres_text: Hypocentres: NonLinLoc (EDT likelihood, oct-tree) in the 3D merged Vp/Vs model v{model} (velocity_models.zip in this record), with source-specific station terms and coherence relocation (below), run {run}. Depth is km below sea level (true depth; the Earth-flattening of the travel-time grids is undone). station_terms_v{version}.in: the static terms of the first pass, used only by the deep and edge passes.
params.picks_note: Picks: Cascadia_picks_catalog_v4.1tc.csv.gz in this folder, as in v6.0: the v4.1 picks re-timed on drifting channels (v4.1t, D-B072/D-B075) plus the clock-drift corrections of MH07.XD and MG07.XD (spring 2016, D-B090; columns clock_correction_s, clock_correction_sd_s, clock_epoch, clock_flag, total_correction_s). The other candidate clock epochs wait for the PI's review (v6.2, D-B108). Method: pick_timing_README.md.

columns.M, M_unc, M_type, ML, ML_unc, n_ML, ML_m: converged Route A magnitudes (D-B091) computed with the v6.1 hypocentres (D-B105); magnitude_source names the table
columns.magnitude_source: table of the magnitude columns: v6.1_converged = converged Route A table computed with the v6.1 hypocentres (D-B091, D-B105); v4.1_converged = the same with the v4 hypocentres, for events the v6.1 table has no magnitude for; empty without a magnitude
columns.model_version: velocity model of the travel-time grids (v0.4.2)
columns.loc_pass: NonLinLoc run of the hypocentre: ssst_it2 (final SSST pass), coherence, deep or edge
columns.station_terms: ssst (NLL-SSST, characteristic distances 9999-16 km, D-B103) or static (deep and edge passes)
columns.ssst_char_km: final Loc2ssst characteristic distance of the event's station terms (16 km; empty for static rows)
columns.event_flag: quarry_blast_likely (Texada Island box, weekday working hours) and/or anss_explosion, anss_quarry_blast, anss_other_event, anss_sonic_boom (within 3 s and 20 km of a ComCat event of that type, D-B071; a surface depth is right for these), joined with ';'; analog_test_signal: likely false event from the weekly artificial test signal on the UW analog channels HSR, EDM and STD near Mount St Helens (D-B108; evidence msh_analog_flags.html and msh_analog_candidates.csv in this folder); empty otherwise. A flag only: no event is removed

method_notes: Model v0.4.2 (D-B099, D-B104): model v0.4.1 (re-inverted with the re-timed picks and the tomoDD surface floor, D-B082, D-B083) with event self-pairs removed from the inversion data and a tomoDD numerical fix. Travel-time grids as for v5.1 and v6.0: merged solid surface (D-B068), fine and wide grids, deep pass below 80 km (D-B067).

Source-specific station terms (NLL-SSST, Loc2ssst; Lomax & Savvaidis 2022): two passes, characteristic distances 9999 and 16 km (D-B103). A pre-registered depth test (Axial, Mount St Helens, western Blanco, Gorda Depression) kept only this schedule with coherence within the held-out-fit gate; v6.0's further passes at 8 and 4 km deepened events through the trade-off between station terms and depth. The deep and edge passes use the static terms of the first pass (column station_terms).

Coherence relocation (NLL-coherence, Lomax & Savvaidis 2022), as in v6.0: an event with a compact location density is relocated on its density stacked with those of its waveform-coherent neighbours (pair coherence from waveform cross-correlation, D-B040; D-B084). Not applied in the Mendocino region (D-B098; column coherence_skipped_region).
Edge pass: events rejected at a lateral face of their tile box are located again in a box centred on them (column edge_pass).

event_flag marks events that ComCat lists as explosions, quarry blasts or other non-earthquakes (D-B071) and, new in v6.1, likely false events from the weekly artificial test signal on the UW analog channels near Mount St Helens (analog_test_signal, D-B108). Flags only: no event is removed.
review_* columns: the automatic indicators of the v5.1 location review (D-B097); no reviewer verdict is applied in this version.
known_limits: Axial depths: {axial}. The target (85 % of tier A-B events within 2 km of the seafloor) is still missed (v6.0 66 %, v5.1 81 %). Cause (D-B103): the station-term/depth trade-off and a real near-surface Vp/Vs error of the model (common S terms about -60 ms relative to P at Axial, about -150 ms at Puget). Fix path: correct the near-surface Vp/Vs of the model, then relocate. Acceptance report: b4_acceptance_v6.1.html.
Flagged events (event_flag) stay in the catalog and also fed the station terms of this run; station terms without them are a candidate for v6.2.

Deferred to v6.2 (D-B108): the other candidate station clock epochs (129, including the Axial cabled array, Dec 2014 - Jan 2015) and the location-review verdicts (1,512 events; review_not_earthquake, review_depth_unreliable, review_relocate, review_depth_km empty).
No coherence relocation in the Mendocino region (D-B098; 10,500 compact events keep their final SSST location). Provisional.
floor_limited, far_only and five_phase events have poorly constrained depths, as in v6.0 (counts above).
